example.title: Zilwaukee Bridge (I-75 / US 23 over the Saginaw River)

brief: College Rd over the Kettle River, Fenwick-Kessler. Modelled on the Zilwaukee Bridge: a high-level precast segmental concrete box girder (longest span 119.5 m, 38 m over the river, 2.4 km long) on tall tapered single-column piers, the deck rising in a long even grade from the flat floodplain. Here: 120 m spans over the channel, the grade coming down over the basin on 60 m spans. Plain grey concrete, a concrete barrier parapet with a steel rail. Foundations: pile groups under each pier taken 25 m below the modelled bed.
